# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 16 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_016_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 16

**16:1** "Hand back the girl," the priest said to Joseph. "The one you took from the temple." Joseph broke down and wept. "Here is what we'll do," the priest said. "You will both drink the water of testing — the water of divine conviction. If there is sin in you, it will show itself."

**16:2** The priest prepared the ordeal water. First Joseph drank it, and was sent out into the hill country. He came back completely unharmed. Then Mary drank it, and she was sent out as well. She came back unharmed too. The crowd that had gathered watched in amazement. Neither of them had shown any sign of guilt.

**16:3** The priest stood before them. "If the Lord God himself has not revealed sin in you," he said, "then I will not condemn you either." He let them go. Joseph took Mary and they went home together, their hearts full of praise to the God of Israel.
